name: For Unlawful Carnal Knowledge

tenures.source: Won its debut tag match against the Teen Age Killers, and fought a running feud with Ghetto Thunderstorm through the promotion's own last surviving card.

caption: A tag team billed with a deliberately provocative name whose running feud with Ghetto Thunderstorm ran the length of the promotion's own surviving record.

name: Ghetto Thunderstorm

tenures.source: Formed on-air when Devon Henderson saved "Lightning Feet" Deon Langston from an ambush, then won its feud with For Unlawful Carnal Knowledge on the promotion's own last surviving card.

caption: A tag team born from a mid-match rescue that grew into the promotion's own longest-running feud.
